html:
Da Nang City Full Day Tour is an excellent introduction to the most modern and vibrant coastal city in Central Vietnam. This tour combines iconic landmarks, cultural sites, spiritual attractions, and local cuisine, offering travelers a comprehensive view of Da Nang in just one day.

ITINERARY

08:30
Driver and English-speaking tour guide from Vietlook Travel pick you up at your hotel lobby in Da Nang.

09:00
Begin the city sightseeing tour:

  • Love Bridge – a romantic symbol of Da Nang

  • Photo stops at Da Nang’s famous bridges, known as “the four most beautiful bridges of the city”:

    • Dragon Bridge

    • Han River Swing Bridge

    • Tran Thi Ly Bridge

    • Thuan Phuoc Bridge

Continue to Linh Ung Pagoda (Son Tra Peninsula) – the largest and most impressive spiritual site in Da Nang. Admire the 67-meter high Lady Buddha statue and enjoy a panoramic view of the city, coastline, and mountains. You may also see the friendly brown monkeys living in the area.

11:00
Visit Da Nang World Wonders Park, featuring miniature models of famous landmarks such as the Statue of Liberty, Eiffel Tower, and other world icons — a popular photo spot, especially for young travelers.

11:30
Stop at APEC Park, famous for its kite-shaped architectural design, one of the newest landmarks in Da Nang. Visit the exhibition gallery inside the park.

12:00
Lunch at a local restaurant. Enjoy Da Nang specialties such as rice paper rolls with pork, Quang noodles, and other local dishes.

13:30
Visit the Cham Sculpture Museum, home to the world’s largest collection of Cham artifacts and sculptures.

14:30
Visit Linh Ung Pagoda (Ngu Hanh Son / Marble Mountains area) – one of Da Nang’s largest pagodas, offering peaceful scenery and spiritual atmosphere.

16:00
Return to your hotel.
End of tour services. Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel!

TOUR PRICE: USD 42 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for transfers

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Mineral water on the coach

  • Entrance fees for all sightseeing activities as per itinerary

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Please provide personal information: Full name, year of birth, gender, nationality, and contact details.

  • Children policy:

    • 1–4 years old: Free of charge (sharing lunch with parents)

    • 5–9 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion lunch)

    • Above 9 years old: Full adult price
